theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 14 群

items.pos: n. 報告 | v. 匯報
items.colloc: annual report 年度報告 | submit a report 提交報告
items.distinct: account 帳戶說明 | record 記錄
ex: Please submit your weekly report by Friday afternoon.
請在週五下午前提交你的每週報告。
The department manager reported the sales figures to the CEO.
部門經理向執行長匯報了銷售數據。
This new report highlights the need for market expansion.
這份新報告強調了市場擴張的必要性。

items.pos: n. 代表 | adj. 有代表性的
items.colloc: sales representative 銷售代表 | customer representative 客服代表
items.distinct: delegate 代表（會議） | agent 代理人
ex: A sales representative will visit your office next week.
銷售代表下週會拜訪您的辦公室。
She is the legal representative for the overseas branch.
她是海外分公司的法律代表。
The survey results are representative of our entire client base.
調查結果足以代表我們所有的客戶群。

items.colloc: respond to an email 回覆郵件 | respond quickly 迅速回應
items.distinct: answer 回答問題 | react 反應
ex: Please respond to the client's inquiry as soon as possible.
請儘快回應客戶的詢問。
Management did not respond to the employees' request for a raise.
管理層未對員工的加薪請求做出回應。
How should we respond to the competitor's recent price cut?
我們該如何應對競爭對手最近的降價策略？

items.colloc: restrict access 限制存取 | strictly restricted 嚴格限制
items.distinct: limit 限量 | curb 控制
ex: The company restricts internet access during working hours.
公司在工作時間限制網路存取。
Budget cuts will restrict our ability to hire new staff.
預算削減將限制我們聘僱新員工的能力。
Building codes restrict the height of structures in this area.
建築法規限制了該區域建築物的高度。

items.pos: n. 搜尋 | v. 尋找
items.colloc: job search 求職 | search for information 搜尋資訊
items.distinct: examine 檢查 | look for 找尋
ex: Our team is conducting a search for a new office location.
我們的團隊正在搜尋新的辦公室地點。
You can search for available files on the company server.
你可以在公司伺服器上搜尋可用的檔案。
They searched through the archives for historical data.
他們在檔案庫中搜尋歷史數據。

items.pos: adj. 安全的 | v. 確保
items.colloc: secure a contract 獲得合約 | secure connection 安全連線
items.distinct: safe 安全的 | protect 保護
ex: We need to secure the office doors before leaving.
離開前我們必須確保辦公室門已鎖好。
It was difficult to secure funding for the new project.
為新專案爭取到資金相當困難。
Please ensure that your data is stored in a secure location.
請確保你的資料存放在安全的地方。

items.colloc: seek advice 尋求建議 | seek employment 尋求就業
items.distinct: search 搜尋 | look for 找尋
ex: The firm is seeking a candidate with relevant experience.
這家公司正在尋求有相關經驗的候選人。
You should seek professional advice before signing the agreement.
簽署合約前你應該尋求專業建議。
We are seeking new ways to improve operational efficiency.
我們正在尋求改善營運效率的新方法。

items.colloc: serve as... 擔任…… | customer service 客戶服務
items.distinct: assist 協助 | provide 提供
ex: He has served as the company director for ten years.
他已擔任公司董事十年之久。
This new policy will serve to reduce waste significantly.
這項新政策將有助於大幅減少浪費。
Our staff is dedicated to serving every customer with care.
我們的員工致力於用心服務每一位客戶。

items.colloc: marketing strategy 行銷策略 | develop a strategy 制定策略
items.distinct: tactic 戰術 | plan 計畫
ex: We need a long-term strategy to stay ahead of rivals.
我們需要一項長期策略以保持領先競爭對手。
The marketing strategy focuses on digital media platforms.
該行銷策略著重於數位媒體平台。
The board of directors approved the company's growth strategy.
董事會批准了公司的成長策略。

items.pos: adv. 大大地 | 相當多地
items.colloc: substantially increase 大幅增加 | substantially different 截然不同
items.distinct: considerably 相當地 | significantly 明顯地
ex: Sales have grown substantially over the last two quarters.
過去兩季銷售額大幅增長。
The new design is substantially better than the previous one.
新設計比之前那款好得多。
Operational costs were reduced substantially after the merger.
合併後營運成本大幅降低。

items.pos: adj. 優越的 | n. 上司
items.colloc: superior quality 優良品質 | report to a superior 向主管匯報
items.distinct: excellent 極好的 | senior 資深的
ex: Our company is known for providing superior customer support.
我們公司以提供優質的客戶支援而聞名。
You should discuss this matter with your direct superior.
你應該與你的直屬主管討論此事。
This software offers superior features compared to other tools.
與其他工具相比，這套軟體提供更優越的功能。

items.colloc: be supposed to 應該 | suppose that 假設
items.distinct: assume 假定 | imagine 想像
ex: We are supposed to submit the project by noon today.
我們應該要在今天中午前提交該專案。
What do you suppose is the reason for the delay?
你認為造成延誤的原因是什麼？
Let us suppose the market demand drops suddenly next month.
讓我們假設市場需求下個月會突然下降。

items.pos: n. 總數 | adj. 總體的
items.colloc: total amount 總金額 | total sales 總銷售額
items.distinct: sum 總和 | aggregate 總計
ex: The total cost of the renovation exceeded our budget.
裝修的總成本超出了我們的預算。
Please calculate the total number of hours worked this week.
請計算本週工作的總時數。
The total attendance for the conference was over five hundred.
此次會議的總出席人數超過五百人。

items.colloc: factory tour 工廠參觀 | take a tour 參加導覽
items.distinct: trip 旅行 | travel 移動
ex: We will take a guided tour of the production facility.
我們將參加生產設施的導覽參觀。
The manager is currently on a business tour of Asia.
經理目前正在亞洲進行商務巡迴。
Visitors are welcome to take a tour of our showroom.
歡迎訪客參觀我們的展示間。

items.pos: adj. 傳統的 | 慣例的
items.colloc: traditional method 傳統方法 | traditional business 傳統企業
items.distinct: conventional 習慣的 | customary 習俗的
ex: The company is moving away from traditional marketing methods.
公司正逐漸捨棄傳統的行銷方式。
It is a traditional practice to hold a staff party annually.
每年舉辦員工派對是傳統慣例。
We combine traditional craftsmanship with modern technology.
我們將傳統工藝與現代科技相結合。

items.colloc: training session 訓練課程 | job training 職前訓練
items.distinct: education 教育 | practice 練習
ex: All new employees must attend the mandatory training session.
所有新進員工都必須參加強制性的培訓課程。
She received excellent training before starting her new role.
她在開始新職位前接受了完善的培訓。
The company offers ongoing training for all staff members.
公司為所有員工提供持續性的培訓。

items.colloc: transform the business 轉型企業 | completely transform 完全改變
items.distinct: change 改變 | modify 修改
ex: The new leadership aims to transform the company's culture.
新領導階層旨在變革公司文化。
Innovative technology has transformed the way we work today.
創新科技已經改變了我們今天的工作方式。
We plan to transform this warehouse into a modern office.
我們計畫將這間倉庫改造為現代化的辦公室。

items.colloc: fair treatment 公平對待 | medical treatment 醫療
items.distinct: therapy 治療療法 | handling 處理
ex: The company ensures fair treatment for all its employees.
公司確保所有員工都受到公平對待。
He is undergoing medical treatment for his back injury.
他正在接受背部受傷的醫療治療。
The proposal suggests a new treatment for waste disposal.
該提案建議了一種廢棄物處理的新方法。

items.pos: adj. 不確定的 | 不可靠的
items.colloc: uncertain future 不確定的未來 | remain uncertain 保持不確定
items.distinct: unsure 不確信 | doubtful 可疑的
ex: The economic climate remains uncertain for the next quarter.
下一季的經濟氛圍仍處於不確定狀態。
I am uncertain about the schedule for tomorrow's meeting.
我不確定明天會議的行程安排。
The outcome of the negotiations is still highly uncertain.
談判結果目前仍充滿高度不確定性。

items.colloc: usually happen 通常發生 | not usually 不常
items.distinct: generally 大體上 | normally 正常地
ex: Our weekly staff meeting is usually held on Mondays.
我們的每週員工會議通常在星期一舉行。
We usually receive a response within two business days.
我們通常在兩個工作日內收到回覆。
The office is usually quiet during the lunch hour.
午餐時間辦公室通常很安靜。
